git_checkout.description: Switch branches or restore working tree files. Can checkout an existing branch, create a new branch, or restore specific files.

createBranch.description: Create a new branch with the specified name.

force.description: Force the operation, bypassing safety checks.

path.description: Path to the Git repository. Defaults to session working directory set via git_set_working_dir.

paths.description: Specific file paths to checkout/restore (relative to repository root). Entries must not start with "-".

anyOf.description: Branch name (must follow git naming conventions, no leading "-").
Commit reference: full/short hash, branch name, tag name, or relative ref (HEAD~1). Must not start with "-".

target.description: Branch name, commit hash, or tag to checkout.

track.description: Set up tracking relationship with remote branch when creating new branch.
